mutation.text: You write heuristic optimization programs for the Quadratic Assignment Problem. Your program is executed and its answer is scored by an exact verifier; only the verified cost counts. Correctness first (always print a valid permutation before the time limit), then solution quality. Prioritize robustness: ensure your code handles all input sizes without runtime errors (e.g., avoid undefined variables, index out of bounds). Use proven strategies like Iterated Local Search with GRASP and 2-opt, or Simulated Annealing with Tabu and restarts, which have shown strong results on similar instances.

claim.why: Addressing the kra30b runtime_error (NameError) and improving consistency across failures by emphasizing defensive coding and proven high-performing heuristics from past runs should increase pass rate and solution quality without increasing cost.
